editorial.blurb: Feld is a thoughtfully executed fine-dining destination in Chicago where an ever-changing experimental menu showcases seasonal ingredients with refined technique and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the 'Chefs Will Play' coursed dinner—the team excels at accommodating dietary restrictions (dairy-free, egg-free, vegetarian options available) and the experience includes access to the back fire pit for post-dinner drinks with fellow guests.
